title: Uncle Mike's Fishing

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Fishing is merely a vehicle for what we really offer: cherished memories that will last a lifetime! We specialize in family fishing. Hundreds of youngsters have caught their first fish on our boat! Most of this beginner fishing takes place in the calm waters of Shinnecock Bay. The ocean is readily accessible for “bottom fishing” at productive local wrecks, trolling, or drifting in the Shinnecock Inlet. "If you get a chance to fish with Captain Mike, grab it! Nobody tries harder to show his clients a great time on the water." ... Capt.
